cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount recorded on cancelWithdrawal, the HYPE value to be re-delegated
cancelled_withdrawal_amount.checkpoint: before redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reads and resets it

redelegated_amount.meaning: amount actually re-delegated via _distributeStake SpotDeposit (truncatedAmount = amount / 1e10 * 1e10, remainder dropped)

stranded_amount.meaning: cumulative HYPE left permanently stranded in StakingManager outside accounting as cancel-and-redelegate operations accumulate

assumptions: The re-delegation trigger is the MANAGER_ROLE call to redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reading and resetting _cancelledWithdrawalAmount.
Conservation is asserted at the amount level: the full cancelled amount should be re-delegated (or remainder retained in hypeBuffer), not dropped.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a concrete _cancelledWithdrawalAmount value; the per-call loss is bounded only as amount % 1e10 < 1e-8 HYPE, so the exact stranded magnitude cannot be bound numerically.
Whether the stranded HYPE is truly permanent/unrecoverable is stated only as potential, not demonstrated.

limitations: Conservation relation is expressed between the recorded cancelled amount and the re-delegated amount; the remainder-loss magnitude is bounded only qualitatively.
Permanence of stranding is potential per the report and not formalized as a hard invariant.
